name: DTView2

The exact 1.5b upstream archive is unresolved. The current https://aminet.net/gfx/show/DTView2.lha has SHA-256 f8d48f0a35a55fa7b148ed379d44ef0b06e09eff02bcb98ebf346bd9a4eb122b and contains version 1.7; none of its files match these stock inputs.
